allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\\Program Files\\nodejs","C:\\Program Files \(x86\)\\nodejs","$env:APPDATA\\npm","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 20 Name,FullName)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files" -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'node|nvm' }; Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files \(x86\)" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'node|nvm' }; Write-Output "---choco---"; Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "---winget---"; Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "---appdata local---"; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'node' })

PowerShell(Write-Output $env:PATH; Write-Output "---"; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name; Write-Output "---volta/fnm---"; Get-Command volta,fnm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
